title: Pasulka's Encounters source: daughter of a man thought to be in a secret space program who kept saying 'simulacra'

tellings.quote: Pasulka's source in her new book Encounters was the daughter of somebody who she thought was in a secret space program. One thing that will always give me the chills from that account is that her father would constantly refer to the word simulacra at lunch tables with his colleagues.

plain: One source in Encounters, a 2023 book by the writer Diana Pasulka, was the daughter of a man Pasulka believed worked in a secret space program, meaning a hidden government space effort. The daughter said her father kept using the word "simulacra", meaning copies that stand in for something real, at lunch with his colleagues. Michels repeats this from the book in an episode about whether we live in a hologram, and says it always gives him chills.
